transcript.content: Hi, I'm Dr. Smith. I'm glad you came in today. What’s been going on that brought you here?

For the past four days, I've been feeling completely numb and empty inside, unable to feel any positive emotions. Even when good things happen, I can't seem to experience any happiness or joy at all. It's like my emotions have just been totally blocked.
You mentioned feeling this way for four days—has this low mood been present most of the day, nearly every day since then?
Yes, it has been completely constant. This feeling of numbness and emptiness has been there nearly all day, every single day for the past four days. It just doesn't seem to lift at all.
Did this change in your mood start shortly after a stressful life event or major change?

Yes, it started suddenly exactly four days ago, right after a highly stressful and overwhelming event. Immediately after it happened, it felt like a switch flipped in my mind and I just went completely numb.

{
  "category": "differential point",
  "subcategory": "reexperiencing symptoms",
  "question": "Since that event, have you been having intrusive memories, nightmares, or flashbacks related to it?"
No, I haven't really been having any nightmares or flashbacks about what happened. I don't seem to be experiencing those kinds of intrusive memories either.
Have you felt detached from yourself, your body, or your surroundings—like things seem unreal or dreamlike—since the event?

Yes, I've been feeling exactly like that. It feels like I'm detached from my own body, almost like an outside observer watching myself go through the motions. On top of that, everything around me has felt completely unreal and foggy, as if I'm living in a dream.

{
  "category": "symptom presence",
  "subcategory": "duration of dissociative symptoms",
  "question": "Have these feelings of detachment and unreality been present for most of the day, nearly every day, since the event four days ago?"

Yes, they have been present almost constantly. Ever since the event happened four days ago, I've felt this way for most of the day, every single day. It feels like this strange state of unreality and detachment just won't go away.

{
  "category": "diagnostic confirmation",
  "subcategory": "functional impairment",
  "question": "Have these symptoms been significantly interfering with your ability to function at work, school, or in social relationships?"
I'm not quite sure, and I haven't really thought about how it's affecting my daily life yet. I've mostly just been feeling so overwhelmed and numb over the last few days.

{
  "category": "functional assessment",
  "subcategory": "occupational and social functioning",
  "question": "Have you had trouble carrying out your usual daily activities, such as going to work, taking care of responsibilities, or spending time with others?"

I'm not really sure because I haven't been able to focus on my normal activities at all. I've just been feeling so numb and detached lately that I haven't really been able to pay attention to my daily responsibilities.

{
  "category": "functional assessment",
  "subcategory": "level of distress and impairment",
  "question": "Would you say these symptoms are causing you significant distress or making it hard to function in important areas of your life, like work or relationships?"
I'm not really sure how it's affecting my work or relationships yet, as I haven't thought about that much. I've just been so focused on how confusing and unsettling this complete numbness is.
